US-02 frontend (flow step 4) is done: all the unit, component and e2e tests pass. The scan-secrets script exits 1, but only for `logs/sessions/**` files, not for any code I wrote. I did not push, did not switch branches and did not touch any test or `backend/tests`.

**Commits** (each carries `Refs: US-02-T-NN, US-02-AC-NN, ADR-…` and the Co-Authored-By trailer):

| Task | ACs | SHA |
|---|---|---|
| T-15: add `plans` to the nginx allow-list regex | AC-01, AC-19 | 7b698a2 |
| T-18: `QuoteStore.plan()`, `choosePlan`, `prunePlan`, `plan` entry validated at the boundary | AC-03, AC-13, AC-14 | bcd49c0 |
| T-20: `summaryStepGuard` | AC-15 | 1491d73 |
| T-16: `price-rules.ts`, `money-format.ts`; `ageOn`, `parseIsoDate` and `YearMonthDay` exported from `field-validators.ts` for reuse | AC-06, AC-07 | 4f032ce |
| T-17: `plan.model.ts`, `plan.ts`, `plan-api.ts`, `plan-store.ts` | AC-01, AC-08..AC-11 | 93ce8da |
| T-19, T-20, T-21: `PlanListPage` (ts, html, css) and routes | AC-01..AC-05, AC-11, AC-16..AC-18 | c389874 |
| Fix: radio `z-index` above the stretched label, found by e2e | AC-03 | 3b0efdd |
| `specs/US-02/tasks.md`: T-15 to T-21 marked done | — | the final `docs(us-02)` commit |

Two things about the commit order. 1491d73 (the guard) was committed before 93ce8da (the `PlanStore` it imports), so it does not build on its own. A shell quoting slip caused that, so the history is not strictly bisectable. The 4f032ce commit also touches `field-validators.ts`.

**Files and choices not named in the brief**
- I added `core/plan-store.ts`. It is an in-memory cache of the offered plans per country for one page load, shared by the page and the guard, so there is one plans request per load. A failed or empty answer is never cached, so "Reintentar" always asks again.
- I added `title` to the routes: the page title on `planes` and `Cotizador de seguro de auto` on the `:country` parent. Without the parent title, step 1 would keep the step 2 title after "Atrás".
- `money-format.ts` casts `useGrouping: 'always'` through `unknown`, because the project's ES2022 typings lack that ES2023 value. Without it, es-CO leaves four-digit amounts ungrouped.
- The page uses a `role="radiogroup"` named by the `h1`, native radios with the label stretched over each card, and `Reintentar` via the existing `LoadError`. The CSS is a responsive grid.
- The summary guard reuses `wizardStepGuard` for the step 1 check, then checks the plan. A failed plans request redirects to `/planes`.

**Commands and results**
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json` is clean, and so is `tsconfig.app.json`.
- `npm test` passes 590 tests in 15 files. This includes `plan-list-page.spec.ts`, the replaced US-01 test, `quote-store-plan.spec.ts`, `summary-step-guard.spec.ts`, `plan.spec.ts`, `plan-api.spec.ts`, `price-rules.spec.ts` and `money-format.spec.ts`.
- `npm run lint` and `ng build` are clean.
- The ADR-0004 grep `ReactiveFormsModule|FormControl|FormGroup|FormRecord|signals-compat` over `frontend/src/app` finds nothing. I also found no `bypassSecurityTrust*`.
- The factor-literal grep (`\b(120|110|90)\b` over `frontend/src/app`, excluding specs) matches only `shared/price-rules.ts`. That meets the ADR-0007 Confirmation.
- Stack `docker compose -p mci-fe up -d --build --wait` started healthy.
  - The two US-02 e2e files first gave 31 passed and 7 failed. The cause was my stretched-label overlay intercepting Playwright's click on the radio, fixed in 3b0efdd. After the fix and a rebuild: 38 of 38 passed.
  - The full suite ran twice with the fix, 78 of 78 passed each time (18.9 s each), with one login per run. Stack torn down with `docker compose -p mci-fe down -v`.
- `bash scripts/scan-secrets.sh` printed its complete output and exits 1. Every `SECRET?` line is in `logs/sessions/2026-11-21-067ab97b/**` (the main-session and subagent transcripts). There are none in `frontend/`, `backend/`, `specs/` or `adr/`. The orchestrator needs to decide how to handle those log files. I did not touch them.

**Tests still red:** none. I believe no test is wrong.

**Deviations from the spec or ADRs:** none. As a heads-up, the harness moved the first e2e run to the background after 180 s. I did not start any background command myself, and `ng serve` was never used.

**For the HC3 manual checks (T-22):** the AC-18 screenshots at 360×740 and 1280×800 are still to do, and so are the visual style of the "Recomendado" badge and the screen-reader announcement, which the Step 3 decisions assigned to manual checks.
